I checked this. The concern is valid for one path.

Current post-review automation is already correct: when a review synthesis returns `SHIP` and `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVE=true`, the handoff policy dispatches `agent-self-approve` instead of stopping on the review verdict ([`.agent/src/handoff.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/6cf7ec8b87919ae546d790bfa92a44187ab8d7a5/.agent/src/handoff.ts#L461-L470), covered by [test](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/6cf7ec8b87919ae546d790bfa92a44187ab8d7a5/.agent/src/__tests__/orchestrate-handoff-cli.test.ts#L1051-L1068)).

The remaining bug is initial/manual PR orchestration. `decideManualOrchestration()` still reads GitHub’s PR `reviewDecision`, and if it sees `CHANGES_REQUESTED` it dispatches `fix-pr` directly ([`.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/6cf7ec8b87919ae546d790bfa92a44187ab8d7a5/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L1288-L1304)). There is even a test locking in that old behavior ([test](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/6cf7ec8b87919ae546d790bfa92a44187ab8d7a5/.agent/src/__tests__/orchestrate-handoff-cli.test.ts#L869-L879)).

I’d fix it this way:

1. In `decideManualOrchestration()`, keep the open-PR status check, but when `allowSelfApprove` is true, dispatch `agent-self-approve` before consulting `reviewDecision`.
2. Let `agent-self-approve.yml` own the safety gate. Its prepare step already requires a trusted current-head `SHIP` synthesis before running the approval agent ([`prepare-self-approve.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/6cf7ec8b87919ae546d790bfa92a44187ab8d7a5/.agent/src/cli/prepare-self-approve.ts#L90-L104)).
3. Keep the existing `CHANGES_REQUESTED -> fix-pr` behavior only when self-approval is disabled.
4. Update the manual orchestration tests to cover both cases.
5. Slightly clarify the orchestrator prompt so “human decision” becomes a self-approval-agent `BLOCKED` outcome, not an earlier router/orchestrator stop; the self-approval prompt already has that verdict ([`.github/prompts/agent-self-approve.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/6cf7ec8b87919ae546d790bfa92a44187ab8d7a5/.github/prompts/agent-self-approve.md#L27-L30)).

So yes: when self-approve is enabled, the manual PR path should stop using GitHub’s human `reviewDecision` as the deciding branch and should consult `agent-self-approve` instead.
